jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description
The Lead Digital Product Manager is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the lifecycle of two or more products in Allstate's growing product portfolio. Lead Digital Product Manager manages strategic product vision, product discovery and roadmaps to maximize the customer and enterprise value provided by their product. Lead Digital Product Manager also collaborates with a Product Marketing Manager to plan and execute an integrated marketing plan to support market awareness and adoption for their product, as applicable.

Key Responsibilities
- Help drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Independent Agent (IA) and Specialty Vehicle (SV) capabilities on C3, with a focus on Sales experiences, while supporting service experiences and progressing on the migration of legacy products, processes, and systems to modern platforms.

- Drive delivery across multiple cross-functional product teams, partnering with Product, Distribution, Operations, and Experience Design to prioritize capabilities such as agent enablement, white labeling, comp rater integrations, AMS integrations, and customer migration readiness.

- Serve as a player-coach and strategic leader, influencing enterprise decisions, mentoring Digital Product Managers, and navigating complex tradeoffs across product, platform, channel, and migration initiatives to deliver long-term business value.

- Invest significant time with current and potential customers to understand their needs & habits and to elicit their feedback to potential product concepts and/or released product iterations.

- Engage in discovery/test & learn activities to quickly validate concepts as appropriate for backlog investments.

- Define and manage KPIs to measure the success of your efforts and to inform the overall product strategy.

- Create, drive and execute holistic product strategy (i.e. not limited to software development) for 2 or more products in our growing digital product portfolio.

- Lead development and recommendation of new techniques and processes to support innovative solutions

- Coach and mentor members of the team as well as members of the cross-functional development organization

- Partner with stakeholders inside and outside of the enterprise, and present to field teams and at events as the “product expert” for your defined product area.

- Make build, buy and/or partner decisions to advance product strategy and maximize KPIs

- Monitor budgets and operational effectiveness; develop strategies for adjusted courses of action

- 10 or more years of experience (Preferred)

The Provincial Product Analytics Consultant is responsible for delivering business insights, performance monitoring, reporting, and analytical solutions that support strategic decision-making across Allstate Canada's personal insurance portfolio. - Provides guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to team members while promoting analytical best practices.

- Experience developing reports, dashboards, or performance monitoring solutions.
- Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
- Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Qualifications:
- Experience with SQL, Python, SAS, or similar analytical tools.
- Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, or reporting automation.
- Familiarity with insurance, financial services, or other data-driven business environments.
